claims.text: Esmolol treats ventricular dysrhythmias after huffing volatile solvents, even when pulseless
claims.quote: A unique aspect of treatment is the use of esmolol to treat ventricular dysrhythmias after huffing volatile solvents, even when pulseless

claims.text: Myocard irritability: use catecholamines such as Epi w caution
claims.quote: Myocardial irritability can be a problem with inhalation exposure; thus, any use of catecholamines such as epinephrine should be undertaken with caution.
claims.locator: The Clinical Assessment and Treatment of Inhalant Abuse (Perm J, 2023)
